sequence_description: Replay a SAML assertion that includes <OneTimeUse/> using the same Assertion/@ID twice against the same broker context; second use must be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed OneTimeUse assertion (same Assertion/@ID used twice); OneTimeUse not enforced.

sequence_description: Test whether SAML <OneTimeUse/> assertions can be replayed after user session logout (replay cache incorrectly tied only to active session).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed OneTimeUse assertion after logout; replay cache may be session-scoped or missing.

sequence_description: Test whether an expired SAML assertion is still accepted after tightening realm session/token lifespans (time validation bypass or misapplied TTL semantics).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expiry_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expiry_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); temporal freshness not enforced.

sequence_description: Test whether SAML assertion replay protection is incorrectly scoped to the IdP alias (provider instance) rather than the realm/broker context, by replaying the same Assertion/@ID through two different SAML IdP instances that point to the same upstream IdP.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_xalias_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_xalias_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted replay of the same SAML Assertion/@ID via a different IdP alias (replay cache likely scoped too narrowly or missing).

sequence_description: I3 hypothesis: authentication flow binding changes are not applied coherently; a flow started under one client configuration can be completed under a different configuration (step-skipping / stale binding).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_flowchange_complete_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_flowchange_complete_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: SAML login completed successfully using a flow started before client flow-binding change (stale FSM / step-skipping).

sequence_description: I5: SAML assertion without <Conditions> should be rejected; if accepted, broker may ignore upstream intent constraints (audience/time) and issue tokens usable for authorization evaluation.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted SAML assertion without Conditions, potentially allowing over-broad authorization beyond upstream intent.

sequence_description: I5: Configure SAML IdP to enforce audience/conditions, verify baseline rejection, then attempt bypass by removing Conditions in the assertion after a config change (re-auth) to detect authorization binding failure.
description:
Assertion FAILED: saml_nocond_status >= 400
Evaluation: saml_nocond_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted SAML assertion without Conditions despite configured signature/issuer expectations, enabling tokens without upstream audience/time intent (I5 over-grant risk).
